summary: Go ahead, just spew poetic Diarrhea over the web phonetic bits loosely joined first it will stink no one comes near but as it gets harder it gets better and suddenly you have a movement and folks will tolerate the presence of your poems #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Go ahead,
just spew poetic
Diarrhea over the web
phonetic bits
loosely joined
first
it will stink
no one comes near
but as it gets harder
it gets better
and suddenly you have a movement
and folks will tolerate the presence of your poems
#smallpoems
